_comment: V0 blind @vision reads of the 1440x900 report#map screen and the 8 standalone overview stems (docs/evidence/map-vision/v0/<repo>/*.png). One read per view; tmux/report-map has two independent reads (p1,p2). Blind: image only, no source, no sibling views. Compact JSON transcribed from the vision transcripts; full prose transcripts remain in the session log.

reads.desc: 1440x900 first screen of report.html#map: 'Workspace — 4 components' node-link with heat 1 fuzz 171.17, 2 . 87.66, 3 regress 86.12, 4 compat 25.33; table below lists findings and file:line links.
reads.action: Open fuzz/cmd-parse-fuzzer.c at lines 50/67/68 and inspect the three PERF-C-ARCH-003 findings.
reads.leg: Headings, labels and table links readable; confidence rings and dot counts too small; bottom row clipped.

reads.desc: Same first screen described independently: heat ranks fuzz 171.17 first; '.' has 7326 findings and 442 high-confidence vs fuzz 57.
reads.action: Open fuzz/cmd-parse-fuzzer.c:50 and read PERF-C-ARCH-003 there.
cant: where time goes inside '.' (7326 findings, no functions named)
reads.leg: Text crisp; bottom row clipped; legend duplicated; node 2 label is just '.'.

reads.desc: No title; ~60 file boxes converge on a single hub 'tmux.h', fanning to compat.h, smalloc.h, compat/imsg.h; caption 'showing top 60 of 216 files'.
reads.action: Inspect tmux.h first — every visible file funnels through it.
reads.leg: Box labels readable; gray edges untraceable where bundled; no legend.

reads.desc: 'File hot-path map — 60 files'; heat = candidate function cost; format.c darkest (30k cost among shown); single tall column + hairline edges to tmux.h/compat.h.
reads.action: Profile format.c first to confirm the static heat.
cant: no absolute time units or edge counts
reads.leg: Filenames/title/legend readable; per-node dots tiny; edge hairlines hard to trace.

reads.desc: 'Entry-stratified cost map — 50 files'; single flat column (no strata); notes '0 resolved call edges; reachability = entries only'.
reads.action: Open format.c (darkest) and profile its entry functions.
reads.leg: Title/labels/footnotes crisp; dot counts/rings barely legible.

reads.desc: 4x4 component matrix, only the '.'x'.' cell filled dark red; no title, no legend, no scale; caption 'call edges are LOW-confidence hypotheses'.
reads.action: Identify the component named '.' — the only highlighted coupling cell.
reads.leg: Labels/caption crisp; cell magnitude and '.' identity unreadable.

reads.desc: 'Hot components — 4 components'; bar = candidate finding density/KLOC; 1 fuzz 171.17, 2 '.' 87.66, 3 regress 86.12, 4 compat 25.33.
reads.action: Profile fuzz first (2x next density).
reads.leg: Title/legend/ranks crisp; lower 80% of canvas empty.

reads.desc: 'Workspace — 4 components'; heat ranks fuzz first; finding dots legend; '1 cyclic edges broken'.
reads.action: Profile fuzz to confirm the candidate findings first.
cant: component 2 label blank and dot count overlaps
reads.leg: Title/legend/numbers crisp; dots and ramp swatches too small.

reads.desc: 'Component bands — 4 components' with file chips; format.c the only dark-red chip; footnotes '+53 more cross-component edges', '+187 more files'.
reads.action: Profile format.c first.
reads.leg: Title/bands/legend readable; band 2 truncates to '…'; tiny dot numbers.

reads.desc: 'Findings map — 50 files'; severity-weighted density; darkest format.c, window-copy.c, window-customize.c, input.c, screen-write.c, server-client.c.
reads.action: Profile format.c and window-copy.c first.
cant: why a file is hot beyond the badge
reads.leg: Filenames/heat readable; numeric badges and confidence dots nearly illegible.

reads.desc: 'Map' with 12-component workspace graph; heat = candidate finding density; table lists components and findings.
reads.action: Profile src/output (84.81) and src/benchmark (82.74) to confirm their candidate findings.
cant: edge direction/call paths and 12 broken cycles
reads.leg: Legends/table links readable; tiny dot rings; node '4 .' unlabelled.

reads.desc: Very wide left-to-right dependency graph, no title, only '25 cyclic edges broken'; faint hairline edges.
reads.action: Open ARCH-001 findings to see the 25 cut cycles.
reads.leg: Unreadable at 100%: extremely wide, untraceable edges, half-empty canvas.

reads.desc: 'File hot-path map · 53 files'; src/command.rs darkest, 'max cost among shown files'; dense caller tangle.
reads.action: Profile src/command.rs first and trace callers.
reads.leg: Node labels readable; central edge tangle unreadable.

reads.desc: 'Entry-stratified cost map — 50 files'; single left column; src/command.rs hottest, then metric.rs, options.rs, benchmark/mod.rs, tests/integration_tests.rs; '0 resolved call edges'.
reads.action: Profile src/command.rs first, then metric.rs/options.rs.
reads.leg: Filenames/footer readable; ~70% of canvas blank; normalised-only heat.

reads.desc: Coupling matrix over 12 modules; darkest cells src↔src/benchmark and tests→tests; no title, no numeric scale.
reads.action: Inspect the darkest cells (src ↔ src/benchmark).
reads.leg: Labels/grid readable; intensity unexplained.

reads.desc: 'Hot components — 12 components'; bar = finding density/KLOC; src/output 84.81, src/benchmark 82.74 at top; src/parameter 4.37 and src/export/json 0.00 at bottom.
reads.action: Profile src/output and src/benchmark to confirm.
reads.leg: Readable at 100%; canvas mostly empty.

reads.desc: 'Workspace — 12 components'; heat ranks src/output 84.81, src/benchmark 82.74; 12 broken cycles noted; graph squeezed into top 40%.
reads.action: Profile the two hottest components first.
reads.leg: Crisp labels/legend; mostly blank canvas.

reads.desc: 'Component bands — 12 components'; deepest red src/command.rs, dark red benchmark/mod.rs/executor.rs and tests; right-edge ribbons unlabelled.
reads.action: Profile src/command.rs first, alongside benchmark/mod.rs and executor.rs.
reads.leg: Bands/title/legend readable; many file labels clipped; ribbons unlabelled noise.

reads.desc: 'Findings map — 50 files' node-link; hottest tests/integration_tests.rs, benchmark/measure.rs; ~25 unlabelled crossing edges.
reads.action: Profile the hottest boxes first.
reads.leg: Box labels/legend readable; middle is a hairball.

reads.desc: 'Workspace — 21 components'; heat ranks '3 tests 151.43' and a test-runners component 214.29; several labels clipped/overlapping.
reads.action: Profile the darkest-red high-density nodes (tests / example_2/test) first.
reads.leg: Most node labels/legend readable; top-right labels overlap into garbled text.

reads.desc: Directed include graph, no title; files fan into a dense bundle converging on cJSON.h; 'showing top 60 of 101 files'.
reads.action: Treat cJSON.h as highest-blast-radius header; scrutinise any edit.
reads.leg: Column labels readable; edges collapse into an unlabelled hairball; clipped text.

reads.desc: 'File hot-path map — 60 files'; max cost is tests/unity/test/tests/testunity.c; test/unity files crowd the graph; mid-path labels truncated.
reads.action: Regenerate with unity/example/test-harness files excluded, then profile.
cant: test files crowd out library heat
reads.leg: Title/legends readable; node labels truncated; edges unreadable.

reads.desc: 'Entry-stratified cost map — 50 files'; footer says max cost is a test file; '0 resolved call edges; reachability = entries only'.
reads.action: Profile the bright-red test file and tests/parse_hex4.c first.
reads.leg: Labels/footnotes readable; dense stem, tiny dots.

reads.desc: Sparse file-path coupling heatmap; 2 dark-red plus ~4 pale cells; no title, no scale, clipped axis labels.
reads.action: Manually inspect the two dark-red call edges.
reads.leg: Grid/footnote readable; label truncation makes cell identity unreliable.

reads.desc: 'Hot components — 21 components'; max 214.29 is an example_2/test/test_runners component; labels left-truncated.
reads.action: Profile the top-ranked test-runners component first.
reads.leg: Values/title crisp; truncated paths make row identity unreliable.

reads.desc: 'Workspace — 21 components'; darkest node is an example_2/test component; several labels overflow or are garbled.
reads.action: Triage the darkest-red example/test node first.
reads.leg: Half-readable: numbers/colours/legend clean; labels overflow/garbled.

reads.desc: 'Component bands - 21 components'; red-hot file in band 18 (tests/unity/test/tests); paths truncated at both ends.
reads.action: Inspect the red-hot test file and its ~14-count dot.
reads.leg: Band headers/legend legible; paths heavily truncated; dots readable but identity often not.

reads.desc: 'Findings map — 50 files'; darkest cJSON_Utils.c (61), tests/misc_tests.c, tests/cjson_add.c (39); ~20 labels left-clipped.
reads.action: Triage the dark-red nodes first (cJSON_Utils.c 61).
reads.leg: Title/legend/colours/badges readable; a third of labels cut off at the left edge.
